offers_products.reason: It installs and prefabricates building systems as part of contracting work; equipment is incidental to the services.

offers_services.reason: Design, installation, management and maintenance of HVAC, electrical and plumbing systems are its core services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are building owners, facility managers, hospitals, universities and manufacturers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: It partners with building owners and facilities managers, including hospitals, manufacturers and universities.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from one-off construction and retrofit projects; maintenance contracts are the smaller recurring part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Largest part is new construction and retrofit projects, which owners can delay in downturns; maintenance work is smaller.

big_ticket.reason: Largest part is MEP construction projects for hospitals, data centers and manufacturers; each project is large and infrequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for skilled trades and engineers installing and maintaining systems; work stops if staff leave.

large_customers.reason: Customers are hospital systems, universities, data center and manufacturing owners, and government facilities, mostly large institutions.

asset_heavy.reason: Contractor needs vehicles, prefab shops and people, not heavy plants or fleets; growth is largely via acquisitions and labor.

notes: Revenue mix between construction projects and maintenance is from general knowledge; the site text does not give it.
